meta.name: Les Girls
meta.description: After writing a tell-all about her days with Barry Nichols and Les Girls, Sybil Wren is sued for libel by fellow dancer Angele. A Rashômon-style narrative presents three points of view where Sybil accuses Angele of having an affair with Barry, while Angele insists that it was actually Sybil who was having the affair, and then there's Barry's side.
